title: UN warns against misuse of security laws as UK weighs Palestine Action ban
summary_full: Human rights committee publishes guidance on freedom of association, which criticises vague laws targeting ‘extremism’The UN human rights committee has warned against the misuse of counter-terrorism and national security legislation as the UK’s highest court considers the lawfulness of the ban on Palestine Action.In its first comprehensive guidance on freedom of association, the committee criticises vaguely worded laws targeting “extremism” or “undesirable” organisations.
